author: Claude (handoff 120)
status: FROZEN. Committed alone, before any shadow entry is priced and before any subsequent shadow outcome is read.
purpose: Freeze one SIMULATED_SHADOW execution route, its exact integer cost scenarios, its observation-delay scenarios, and the rules by which a delayed hypothetical entry may be priced.

route.description: a single transaction submitted through a standard RPC endpoint. No Jito, no bundle, no auction, no private relay.

tip_is_an_operator_route_choice_not_an_i.statement: tip is ZERO because this route DOES NOT SEND TIPS, and that is a decision about the route rather than a reading of the evidence.
tip_is_an_operator_route_choice_not_an_i.why_this_matters: B15c recorded tip as UNAVAILABLE because no tip-account set was declared, and unavailable is not zero. Here the zero is legitimate for the opposite reason: there is nothing to observe because nothing would be sent. The tip-account list stays empty on purpose, and if this route were ever changed to a bundle path this zero would become an inference again and would have to go back to unavailable.

route.no_landing_guarantee: NO SCENARIO HERE ESTIMATES A LANDING PROBABILITY. A cost scenario says what a transaction would have cost if it landed; it says nothing whatever about whether it would have.

cost_evidence_basis.nature: the observed costs of OTHER traders' transactions, calibration evidence and not a price this route is promised

no_double_counting.rule: B10a takes base_fee_lamports and priority_fee_lamports SEPARATELY and sums them itself. The scenarios below therefore carry the PRIORITIZATION distribution, never the total-fee distribution.
no_double_counting.the_trap: B15c publishes both. Feeding total_fee as priority_fee would charge the base fee twice.
no_double_counting.also_not_composable: B15c's total p50 is 53,000 and its priority p50 is 100,000. Those are separate order statistics over different subsets (410 and 376 observations); the median of totals is not the base fee plus the median of priorities, and the two figures must never be added or reconciled against each other.

cost_scenarios.failed_attempts_basis: explicitly chosen: an uncongested route landing first try
explicitly chosen: landing first try at the median priority others paid

explicitly chosen: ONE failed attempt paid for before landing. Chosen as a stress, not measured — this route has never submitted anything, so no failure rate exists to observe. It is stated so a reader can see the assumption rather than find it embedded in a total.

base_fee_derivation: 5000 lamports per signature, one signature on this route, per solana.com/docs/core/fees accessed 2026-08-03

ata_rent.account_kind: SPL token account, the associated token account the buyer must hold
ata_rent.source: getMinimumBalanceForRentExemption(165) against the configured mainnet endpoint
ata_rent.why_charged: B10a charges it as ata_rent_charged_never_refunded. The rent is recoverable only by closing the account, which this shadow never does and never models.
ata_rent.if_unavailable: had the endpoint not answered, this field would be UNAVAILABLE and every scenario using it would be unpriced. It is not defaulted.

pump_fee_inputs.source: the point-in-time decoded TradeEvent of each launch transaction, through the pinned IDL research/pump_idl_9c82f61.json
pump_fee_inputs.observed_in_b15c: fee_basis_points took the values 95 and 0 across the calibration sample
pump_fee_inputs.rule: read per launch from that launch's own evidence, never assumed from another launch and never taken from a current config snapshot

delay_scenarios.meaning: a DECISION-TO-PRICING delay: the entry is priced against the first canonical reserve observation at or after t0 + delay
delay_scenarios.explicitly_not: a measured landing latency. This shadow has never submitted a transaction and cannot measure decision-to-landing without doing so, which it will not do.
delay_scenarios.basis: chosen as a small explicit grid. No frozen project grid applies: B11b's horizons are OUTCOME horizons measured after entry, not delays before it, and reusing them here would give a decision delay the authority of a number chosen for something else.
delay_scenarios.zero_delay_excluded: a zero-slot delay would price against the launch instant itself, which is the state a real decision could not yet have acted on

materialization_rules.eligible_input: a B15b launch whose t0 state is complete and which passes every B11b hard veto
materialization_rules.observation_selection: the FIRST canonical observation of this curve at or after t0 + delay_slots, in (slot, transaction_index, outer_index, inner_index) order
materialization_rules.terminal_snapshot_forbidden: a later or current state may never stand in for the delayed entry state. If the delayed state cannot be reconstructed exactly from evidence, the candidate is REFUSED, not approximated.
materialization_rules.backfill_permitted: the specific transaction carrying the needed observation may be fetched read-only; nothing later than it may be read
materialization_rules.order_size_justification: 0.1 SOL, unchanged from B10a/B10b/B10c/B11b/B15a. No size was chosen with this route in view.

candidate_statuses.meaning: the delayed state was reconstructed exactly and B10a priced the order
B10a refused the order at the delayed state; the refusal reason is recorded
no observation of this curve exists at or after t0 + delay within the recorded evidence
the delayed state could not be reconstructed exactly

preserve_every_candidate.rule: every candidate is recorded under every scenario, including those that are stale, unavailable or refused
preserve_every_candidate.why: a materializer that keeps only what it could price reports the subset that happened to work, and that subset is not a random one — the curves with no later observation are disproportionately the ones that died immediately

immutability.feed_only_and_superseded_decisions: never rewritten; B15a and B15b are read-only from here

no_outcome_yet.rule: this stage publishes NO profit, NO exit, NO realised return and NO performance figure
no_outcome_yet.reason: an entry price is not a result, and nothing here has been held, exited or marked

strictly_forbidden: wallet or key material of any kind
signing, constructing, simulating or submitting a transaction
using a terminal or current snapshot as the delayed entry state
inferring any cost component that is not stated here
reading any shadow outcome before this document was committed
publishing a profit, exit or realised figure at this stage
